steps.name: Home previews inside the composer
steps.goal: Inspect the home composer at the bottom. Do not start a session. Dismiss an Apple Account alert with Not Now if present.
steps.done: The image, video, and file tiles are inside the rounded composer surface, above What should we work on? and above its controls.

steps.name: Home draft keeps the previews
steps.goal: Tap the What should we work on? field and type Keep these files. Do not send.
steps.done: Keep these files appears below the preview tiles inside the same composer. The keyboard is visible and the composer is above it.

steps.name: Remove a home attachment
steps.done: The image tile is removed. The video and file remain above the draft, and Keep these files remains in the field.

steps.name: Chat previews inside the composer
steps.goal: Switch with the fixture button Show chat composer. The explicit tap targets this fixed fixture on iPhone 17 Pro. Do not send.
steps.done: The chat composer shows all three preview tiles inside its rounded surface, above the draft and Chat controls.

steps.name: Remove a chat attachment
steps.done: The video tile is removed. The image and file stay above the unchanged draft inside the chat composer.
